summary: Iteration 2 verification of the two new features (Enterprise Hierarchy rollup tree + Salesforce metadata package) plus regression of the 4-step flow. Backend: 17/17 pytest passing (metadata, filters, get-by-id, create L1/L2/reject L3/L4, hierarchy for L4/L3/L1/404, scaffold zip 200 + 12 files + valid contents). Frontend: SF Package header link href correct (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/api/scaffold/download). Launch flow: picked L1 -> preset load -> filtered 'USD Operating' -> Launch on L4 'Apex Americas - USD Operating' rendered LaunchView with hierarchy-tree showing full 4-level rollup (Apex Global Holdings PLC -> Apex Americas Regional Group -> Apex Americas LLC -> Apex Americas - USD Operating) with 'THIS RECORD' focus marker on the L4; sibling L2s (EMEA + a TEST_ record) also rendered under root as expected. Preview drawer -> Launch record also reaches the same LaunchView + tree (6 nodes). Create L1 regression: submit-create-account-button produces create-success-banner and LaunchView now renders hierarchy-tree containing the new record as the sole self-focused root node.

issues: Pre-existing hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (DataTable.jsx:97). Coming from visual-editor overlay injecting <span> into <option>; not user-visible but console-noisy. Carry-over from iter1.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py hierarchy walk-up is O(N) per level (repeated linear scan). For 19 seeds it's fine; for 10k accounts consider an index/dict lookup once.

hierarchy loop guard: while-True with seen-set is safe from cycles, but no depth cap on recursive build(); if data ever contained a cycle among 'parentRelationship' names not caught by walk-up seen-set, build() could infinite-loop. Add a visited set in build() as belt-and-suspenders.
LaunchView useEffect refetches hierarchy every time record.id changes but does not cache — fine for now but should use react-query (already installed) for consistency.
sf_scaffold.py FILES dict order is used for zip contents; using OrderedDict-like insertion is fine on 3.7+, but consider explicit list to be defensive.
Carry-over: CORS allow_credentials=True with '*' still present.
seed_data_creation: 1 TEST_ L1 record created via UI during regression (TEST_ UI_PW <suffix>). Backend pytest created 2 more TEST_ L1/L2 records. All safe to leave.

Header testid: download-sf-package (anchor href = ${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api/scaffold/download). Zip filename: meridianone-salesforce-package.zip with 12 files.
